import ctypes
import os

# Load the GSL libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# double gsl_ran_binomial_pdf(const unsigned int k, const double p, const unsigned int n)
gsl.gsl_ran_binomial_pdf.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_uint]
gsl.gsl_ran_binomial_pdf.restype = ctypes.c_double


def binomial_pdf(k, p, n):
    """Compute the probability of obtaining k successes in n trials with success probability p."""
    return gsl.gsl_ran_binomial_pdf(ctypes.c_uint(k), ctypes.c_double(p), ctypes.c_uint(n))


def assert_test():
    """Test cases for binomial_pdf function."""
    # Test case 1: Basic test
    assert abs(binomial_pdf(2, 0.5, 4) - 0.375) < 1e-6, "Test case 1 failed"
    
    # Test case 2: Edge case where p = 0
    assert binomial_pdf(0, 0.0, 5) == 1.0, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert binomial_pdf(1, 0.0, 5) == 0.0, "Test case 2 failed"
    
    # Test case 3: Edge case where p = 1
    assert binomial_pdf(5, 1.0, 5) == 1.0, "Test case 3 failed"
    assert binomial_pdf(4, 1.0, 5) == 0.0, "Test case 3 failed"
    
    # Test case 4: k > n should return 0
    assert binomial_pdf(6, 0.5, 5) == 0.0, "Test case 4 failed"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
